name: Kofola CeskoSlovensko a.s.
summary: Kofola CeskoSlovensko a.s., together with its subsidiaries, produces and distributes non-alcoholic beverages in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Slovenia, Croatia, and internationally. It provides carbonated and non-carbonated beverages, water, syrups, jams, Semtex energy drinks, fresh juices, fresh/salad bars, herbal teas, and coffee bean mixtures.
